fees.note: $25 a night for a site without electric; full hookups $50. The same on a Saturday. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation; no out-of-state rate. ReserveOhio's prices for June 2027 nights, read 2026-10-12.

name: Strouds Run State Park

fees.note: $20 a night April 1 to the first Sunday in December, $15 the rest of the year (sites 19 and 20, with a shelter, $25 / $20). First come, first served with self-registration envelopes; the park's concession, Strouds Run Rentals, runs the campground. Read 2026-10-12.

name: Camp Perry RV Park

fees.note: $35.00-$53.94 a night, $800 a month; the RV park's page gives only the range. Every site has 30/50-amp electric, water and sewer. Read 2026-10-12.
